title_en:
About the Job
Remote English Teaching Opportunity

items.text_sr: Potpuno remote pozicija online predavaca sa fleksibilnim rasporedom, internacionalnim ucenicima i dugorocnom saradnjom. Radi odakle zelis, izgradi stabilan mesecni prihod i unapredi predavacke vestine uz podrsku.
items.text_en: Fully remote online teaching position with flexible scheduling, international students, and long-term collaboration potential. Work from anywhere, build stable monthly income, and grow your teaching skills with structured support.

items.text_sr: Potreban je tecan engleski, pozeljan jasan americki ili britanski akcenat, profesionalna komunikacija, stabilan internet i mirno okruzenje za rad. Iskustvo je plus. Prijave se pregledaju svakodnevno.
items.text_en: Fluent English, clear American or British accent preferred, professional communication, reliable internet, and a quiet teaching setup. Teaching experience is a plus. We review applications daily.
